metadata.title: India's Biggest Trade Fair for Organic, Natural & Millets Industry I APEDA Pavilion @ BIOFACH 2025
metadata.description:
We visited the APEDA Pavilion at BIOFACH INDIA 2025, the country’s leading trade fair for the organic, natural, and millets industry held from 30th August to 1st September 2025. Organized alongside Natural Expo India and Millets India. The event once again brought together the entire ecosystem under one roof, creating a vibrant platform to source, network, and exchange ideas. We were elated to capture the energy of the pavilion and the inspiring voices of industry leaders and entrepreneurs who are shaping the future of sustainable food in India.

Among the highlights was Ujwala Vemparala, Founder and CEO of Rus Organic Juices, who spoke about her journey of creating nourishing cold-pressed juices. We also met Gopal, an organic farmer from Uttarakhand, who showcased the famous Chakrata rajma and traditional Pisyun Loon and spices. Giriraj Agarwal of Orgrain India shared insights on his range of rose-based products. Manen Ozukum of The Green Caravan presented organic products and artisanal wines from Nagaland. From Tamil Nadu, Gautam K R of Viridia Biotech LLP discussed his work with Moringa-based products that are gaining global recognition. Monica Kohli Srivastava and Avinash Srivastava of Agrimax Foods highlighted their healthy millet cookies, while Avinash Awasthi of Elworld Agro offered a taste of millet kheer and traditional sweets. Krishan Guptaa of Organic Wellness spoke about his diverse portfolio that includes health teas, ketchup, and even traditional dant manjan, and Yojna Bhardwaj of Golden Cubes introduced her innovative range of natural jaggery cubes. Each one of them shared their vision and commitment to building a healthier, organic future.

The video concludes with a special message from Abhishek Dev, Chairman of APEDA (Agricultural and Processed Food Products Export Development Authority), who emphasized the pivotal role of APEDA in promoting India’s agricultural and processed food exports, while fostering global opportunities for organics, naturals, and millets. This compilation is a glimpse into the passion, innovation, and dedication that made the APEDA Pavilion a true highlight of BIOFACH INDIA 2025.
